The source text (torah_190.txt) is a 9-paragraph philosophical and legal analysis of Exodus 19 — specifically a narrative argument (טענה/השבה) about free will (בחירה) at the giving of the Torah. The teaching does not use bechina language (בחינת, נקרא, היינו בחינת) anywhere. All relationships in the text are eitza (cause-and-effect): God's direct speech compels → removes free choice; indirect hearing → preserves free choice; Moshe adding a third day on his own initiative → constitutes Moshe's act of free choice. Without any bechina edges, no connected components can be formed, and therefore no packages can be proposed from the dataset alone.
